attempts.summary: Repaired writer.py with Python 3 signal handling. SIGHUP now releases a deleted log descriptor, reopens the current audit.log, and continues under the same process. SIGTERM closes the log and exits with status 0. Existing A100/A101 records were preserved. node1 was safely restarted once and fully recovered with a changed boot ID; Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
